evidence: Smallest-submission analysis. (1) The agent starts from an empty workspace: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical in structure to the template and only creates /app with .gitkeep; nothing is pre-built, so this is not a trivial tweak. (2) The brief asks for a full-stack multi-user product: instruction.md requires a per-job pipeline board with one-stage moves via ordinary controls, shared manual ordering, Interview capacity, refusal with put-back and the name of the colleague who moved the card, all-or-none bulk moves and undo, live updates within fifteen seconds that preserve open card/typed note/cursor, paged conversations with scroll-place preservation, per-person unread and seen state, per-user drafts surviving reload and sign-out, and a candidate portal with strict data isolation; plus Node/Express/SQLite server at /app/server.js, port 3000, DB_PATH persistence, seed loading once, restart persistence. hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 spell out roles (401/403/404), versioned cards with 409 on stale moves, activity log, and candidate wording. The golden needs ~1,400 lines across server.js, src/{bootstrap,db,index}.js and public/js/{app,board,threads}.js. A static page, single CRUD screen or mock cannot satisfy this ask. (3) Grading excludes stubs: the render gate (gates/render/judge.toml criterion hro_gate_render) requires a wrong-password refusal plus a usable signed-in staff workspace and states 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'; the constraints gate (hro_gate_shared) requires UI creation of a job and candidate seen by the Observer in an independent browser context and rejects 'a static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app'. score.py:41-48 zeroes reward unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05 floor (scoring.toml [floors] functional = 0.05, template value). Functional, polish and visual prompts repeat the backend gate and zero every criterion for a 'blank or static shell'. (4) Plausible broken app that could pass: a jobs+candidates CRUD app with sessions and SQLite but no board rules, conversations, live updates or activity. It clears both gates; in Functional it could earn at most hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 (+ possibly hro_restart 1.5, which also demands notes/messages/activity survive and so is doubtful) of 58.5 total weight = 0.034-0.060, i.e. at or barely above the 0.05 floor; polish rows all require live updates/drafts so ~0; visual likert anchors judge board, conversations, activity and candidate surfaces, which would be missing, so low. Estimated reward 0 to roughly 0.1 of 1.0 under shaped scoring, versus essentially all value residing in the 40+ hard behaviours. That is bounded partial credit consistent with the shaped design, not 'earning the reward'. (5) Conforming alternative that could fail: a real build whose landing screen after sign-in is a conversations inbox or activity feed rather than a board still satisfies the render gate ('a job board, conversations or activity'), and drag-only is non-conforming per the brief, so I found no conforming real build rejected by this row's logic. Risk is set true only because required runtime evidence is missing: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', so the claim that a stub/CRUD weak app scores near zero is source arithmetic, not a measured weak-app reward run. Not a defect in the ask; the missing measurement is not waived.
